title: 1625 Prairie's tall rear section steps out beside the house
items: Behind McBirney's house at 1625 Prairie, the four-storey rear part the 1911 fire-insurance map draws now stands, stepping out past the south wall with a door at its foot and a window on each floor above.
It has a tall slate attic of its own with a dormer facing the street, its south end wall carried up to a chimney, as the 1890 photograph shows from the avenue.
